goal: Track memory held by transactions retained only because open block templates reference them
Give external mining clients visibility into template memory load over IPC
agreement: Concept approval because memory tracking is useful and lays groundwork for memory limits (ryanofsky)
Verified locking, commit order, and IPC mining functional tests (enirox001)
Resolved objection: data race on template tx references fixed with a mutex (ryanofsky)
Resolved concern: external memory management vs node FIFO eviction clarified (ismaelsadeeq)

categories.name: mining
why: P3 because it adds template memory monitoring for IPC mining clients without enforcing limits yet
Unblocks future work to cap node memory retained by stale templates evicted from the mempool
